outline:
本課主旨在設計課程，提供練習，俾使學生嫻熟各式的英語測驗，如全民英檢、托福測驗、TOEIC 測驗或類似性質的測驗，希冀能夠藉由本課程的修習，提升學生不斷的學習外國語的興致，並且，藉由通過考試取得證照，增加未來職場的競爭力。
This course is designed to familiarize the students with various kinds of language proficiency tests such as GEPT, TOEFL, TOEIC and many others to the same end. It is our hope that the students who finish taking the course will go on with their enthusiasm on studying foreign languages; besides, through the acquisition of the certificate when the students pass the tests, they are sure to enhance their capability in the increasingly competitive job markets.
schedule:
Week 1: Introduction
Week 2, 3: Part 1-7
Week 4, 5: U1, 2 (10/9 Break)
Week 6, 7: U3, 4
Week 8: Review
Week 9: Midterm Exam
Week 10-11: U5,6
Week 12-13: U7,8
Week 14-15: U9,10
Week 16-17: U11-12
Week 18: Final Exam

This Syllabus may be subject to change or revisions to optimize the educational effect.
assessment:
1. Performance/Quizzes/Assignments 20%
2. Midterm 25%
3. Final 25%
4. Attendance 10% (Five unexcused absences will result in automatic failure of the course)
5. 會考 20%

extended_resources: 課程結合實體授課與線上學習（同步視訊／非同步活動）。
Combines face-to-face instruction with online learning (including synchronous video sessions or asynchronous activities).
參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching)
強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。
Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.
數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources)
採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。
Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.
數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration)
運用生成式AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS等新興科技輔助教學與評量。
Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.
ai_usage: 使用生成式AI作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）
